# M3 results: text-derived signals (auto-generated by src/event_study_text.py) — PRELIMINARY

MFA series come from the T+B1 classifier under codebook v1.2 (see reports/classifier_metrics.md): macro-F1 0.880 (κ 0.791) on a 40-sentence human spot-check hand-labeled by the author (small n; v1.2 was revised from these same 40, so optimistic) and 0.845 on 189 held-out sentences vs. AI labels under v1.2. Since v1.2, statements that only justify a measure already taken (e.g. calling drills 'a firm punishment') count as neither, so MFA action share now tracks announced/reported measures. MFA website boilerplate (288 rows) is excluded.

Coverage: mfa_threat_share: 2022-07-19→2026-10-19 (763 days); mnd_aircraft: 2020-09-16→2026-10-19 (1368 days); mnd_ships: 2022-11-13→2026-10-19 (1025 days)
